note: Wave 10 (2026-10-15). One finding: inclusive versus segregated placement. Directions are relative to the hub (no average difference). Distinct studies: Dalgaard et al. 2022 (all Dalgaard-sourced members) and Doutre et al. 2021 (inclusive preschool). The pull-out LLI claims are left out: both report one Oakland trial, and they bear on scheduling, not placement.

findings.question: Does placing children with special educational needs in inclusive rather than segregated settings change their learning and psychosocial adjustment?
